channel.title: Slow History
channel.description: A private bedtime history podcast made for Augusto Restrepo. Thomas and Clara narrate real, carefully researched history (cities, inventors, ancient worlds) slowly and softly, to help you drift off to sleep.

item.title: Teotihuacan: The Place Where the Gods Were Born
item.description: Henry and Clara walk the Avenue of the Dead in the high valley of Mexico: a city whose own name is lost, the Pyramids of the Sun and Moon, the Feathered Serpent and its glittering hidden tunnel, apartment compounds and painted walls, a quiet morning at the grinding stone, links to the Maya, the great fire, and Aztec pilgrims among the ruins. Ancient Cities, 4 of 4.

item.title: Petra: The Rose-Red City of the Desert
item.description: Henry and Clara walk the Siq into Petra: the Nabataeans and the incense caravans, the Treasury and its legend, a city carved in stone, water saved in the desert, fine painted pottery, the Monastery at sunset, Rome and the earthquakes, and Burckhardt's quiet rediscovery. Ancient Cities, 3 of 4.

item.title: Athens: City of the Owl and the Olive
item.description: Henry and Clara climb the Acropolis: Athena's olive tree, the birth of democracy, the Persian wars, Pericles and the Parthenon, the festival of Athena, the harbour and the long walls, theatre and Socrates, war and plague, and the Parthenon's many lives. Ancient Cities, 2 of 4.

item.title: Babylon: City of the Gate of the Gods
item.description: Henry and Clara drift through Babylon on the Euphrates: clay tablets and cuneiform, Hammurabi's laws, Nebuchadnezzar's city, the blue Ishtar Gate, the ziggurat and the star-watchers, a quiet day on the rooftops, the mystery of the Hanging Gardens, Cyrus and Alexander, and the city that faded into legend. Ancient Cities, 1 of 4.

item.title: Shenzhen, Part 1: The County by the Sea
item.description:
Thomas and Clara drift back through sixteen centuries on the coast that became Shenzhen: Nantou and the salt fields, the walled towns of 1394, Xin'an county, the Great Clearance, Hakka and Cantonese villages, the Opium Wars and the new Hong Kong border, and the little railway market town called Shenzhen. Part 1 of 3.
Chapters: 1. Settling in; 2. The edge of the delta; 3. Nantou, the old seat; 4. Walls against the pirates; 5. Xin'an, a new county; 6. The great clearance; 7. Hakka and Cantonese villages; 8. Ships on the horizon; 9. A railway and a market town; 10. Not just a fishing village; 11. Goodnight.
